cover_headline: Berkshire Operating Earnings Fall 5.8% as Buybacks Hit $9.6 Billion
facts: Berkshire Hathaway's third-quarter operating earnings fell 5.8% to $12.705 billion from $13.485 billion a year earlier
The company bought back about $9.6 billion of its own stock in the third quarter, more than double the $4.5 billion in the second quarter
After-tax insurance underwriting profit fell about 43% to $1.352 billion, and cash and equivalents including Treasury bills totalled $352 billion at the end of September

end.headline: Berkshire Operating Earnings Fall 5.8% as Buybacks Hit $9.6 Billion
end.line: Operating earnings slipped to $12.705 billion on weaker insurance results, while buybacks more than doubled to $9.6 billion.
